changelog: Warlord Prime is now a true final boss: he channels the abilities of every act boss you actually faced this run — barraging, ramping, cursing and mustering all at once — and his shield can no longer be flanked away, so you have to break through it head-on before he enrages. The enemy AI now paths around water and other impassable terrain instead of piling up at the shore, and cards that deploy multiple units now place them in the closest open spaces together. Your buildings-built total finally counts structures raised by Build cards, and run history now shows how many copies of each medal you earned.
